description.value:
You have sworn loyalty to one of the cities of the Lords' Alliance. As an agent of the Alliance, you must uphold its principles and work to make the Sword Coast safer and more prosperous. You are sworn to bring honor and glory to your lord's house, whether that means securing the trade roads for a merchant-lord of Waterdeep or slaying monsters upriver from Daggerford. You have trained in both swordplay and statecraft and are as skilled with a blade as with a quill.

Ability Scores: Strength, Intelligence, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.UVjoQSakHP9e2QnV]{Lords' Alliance Agent}

Skill Proficiencies: Insight and Persuasion

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulCalligraph]{Calligrapher's Supplies}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) 2 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepJavelin000]{Javelins}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulCalligraph]{Calligrapher's Supplies}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagInk00000000]{Ink}, 5 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagInkPen00000]{Ink Pens}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagParchment00]{Parchment} (9 sheets), 13 GP; or (B) 50 GP
